ooRexx Logging Framework v0.7 dependencies

Core LoggingCore.cls + MethodInterposition.cls:
- ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 or compatible

Institutional logging policy integration (LoggingPolicy.cls):
- institutional_policy_v0.6
- alchemy_objects_v0.8 (transitive requirement of Institutional Policy)
- oorexx_crypto_v0.1 (transitive requirement of Alchemy Objects)

NoSQL projections (LoggingNoSQL.cls and LoggingControl.cls runtime adapter):
- nosqlserver_v0.77

Queue direct/topic/persistence targets:
- oorexx_queue_fabric_v0.9-dev4
- alchemy_objects_v0.8
- oorexx_crypto_v0.1

Validated roll-up:
- oorexxapis(20260824-191406).zip

The logging core deliberately does not require Institutional Policy merely to
carry deployment provenance: LogDeploymentContext is a neutral LoggingCore value
object created at activation time.

Security Effect v0.8 remains above/beside Logging rather than a logging-core
dependency because security effects may themselves require logging. The JMS
bridge v0.1-dev2 remains an explicit Queue Fabric boundary concern; its live
adapter is TextMessage-oriented, so v0.7 does not silently flatten LogEvent
objects into JMS text.
